status: LIVE, 2026-11-17: pins of the three open ML rows (docs/design/V3_OPEN_ML_ROWS.md). Nothing here is a hash of a binary we host or build: the packages are pinned by the hashed locks in locks/ (PyPI's own digests, and NVIDIA's own index for TensorRT), the model by the upstream git commit of its repository, the OSS sources by an upstream commit.

python.why: vllm needs >=3.11, jax 0.12 needs >=3.12; the open Linux guest is Ubuntu 24.04 (CPython 3.12)

min_compute_capability_why: Turing and newer: the TensorRT 10.16 wheels carry builder resources for sm75 and up only, the torch 2.14 CUDA 13 wheels start at sm75, vllm 0.34 and jax 0.12 target the same range

model.note: the revision is the commit of the model repository (a git object id, reviewable at the origin); the bytes are checked against the sizes and the sha256 (LFS) or git blob ids the origin's tree API reports for exactly that revision

vllm.title: vLLM offline LLM(...), temperature 0, CUDA graph capture, engine subprocess

tensorrt.title: TensorRT builder + engine (FP16), ONNX Runtime CPU as the reference, ONNX Runtime TensorRT EP

jax.title: JAX / XLA GPU: jit matmul, conv, scan against the CPU, the default memory preallocation, the autotuner
